title: Enter the Big Room at Carlsbad Caverns
description: An elevator carries you deep into Carlsbad Cavern, where the Big Room opens into a vast chamber of illuminated formations. Follow as much of the route as suits you, pausing at columns, draperies, and shapes made over immense stretches of time. The scale is difficult to grasp until you are standing inside it, looking across the chamber rather than at a photograph.
teaser: Take the elevator into a vast underground chamber.
goodToKnow: Full loop is long. Verify elevator operation and the suitability of the chosen route.
whyItMightDelightYou: The cave can make ordinary ideas of size and time feel wonderfully unreliable.
